title: The Self-Consistent Hallucination Loop (SCHL): Emergent Bias in Multi-Agent AI-Driven Scientific Review

contributions.purpose: 构建多智能体 AI-审稿仿真基准
contributions.mechanism: 配对稿件生成(HN-LE vs LN-HE)+ GPT-5/Claude-3.5/Gemini-2.5 三模型审稿 + 对抗共识扰动
contributions.evaluation: N=120 配对稿(24 领域),360 篇审稿;全为合成/仿真数据
contributions.source_quote: We design a reproducible simulation pipeline integrating manuscript generation, multi-agent review, adversarial consensus perturbation, and narrative–evidence decoupling.

contributions.purpose: 提出量化审稿偏差指标
contributions.mechanism: NBI/RDM/LFD/CMRI/HSC 五指标 + 分层贝叶斯/混合效应回归
contributions.evaluation: HN-LE 比 LN-HE 评分高 25.6%,迭代共识使漂移 Δ≈0.70
contributions.source_quote: new quantitative metrics—NBI, RDM, and LFD—for measuring reviewer susceptibility

contributions.mechanism: 论证拒稿=证实偏差、接收=迎合偏差
contributions.evaluation: 不可证伪的循环自证,无数据
contributions.source_quote: the articulation of the SCHL Paradox, showing that both acceptance and rejection empirically validate our claims

notes: 3 条自声明贡献(结论)。重大红旗:(1)循环自证/破坏审稿——“SCHL Paradox” 宣称接收与拒稿都“经验验证”其主张,intro 更直言“if this paper is rejected... the rejection itself becomes empirical evidence”,属胁迫式不可证伪论证;(2)全仿真无真值——“All experiments are simulated to illustrate methodology”,稿件与审稿均 AI 生成,无人类基线;(3)表格数字雷同——三模型 RDM 漂移 Δ=0.70/0.72/0.72、NBI 0.80/0.73/0.78、CMRI 0.81/0.77/0.80,跨家族异常一致;(4)Bootstrap B=250,000 过度,正文含悬空引用 “[?Huang et al., 2024]”(LaTeX 未解析)。属方法学演示型、无实证效力。
